title: 第3章 人就这样不见了第4章 来自修仙界的快递
slug: 快递通两界我带华夏全民修仙
content_zh:
海拔四千六百多米的玉龙雪山，终年被皑皑白雪与翻涌的云雾包裹。
冰川栈道悬在峭壁边缘，脚下是深不见底的悬崖。
这天上午，阳光好不容易穿透云层，给银白的山体镀上一层淡金。
游客们扶着护栏拍照惊叹，李婉一家三口也混在人群里，沿着冰川公园上部站的栈道慢慢往前走。
“婉婉，往这边站一点，妈妈给你拍张照。”
她妈妈王芬举着手机，笑得眉眼温柔，不停调整着角度，“让你爸也过来，咱一家三口一起合个影。”
李婉笑着应了一声，然后脚步便下意识往栈道与山体衔接的位置挪了半步。
这里的石板是景区后期铺设的，边缘嵌着松散的碎石，常年被风雪侵蚀，早已不那么稳固。
她刚站定，脚下却忽然传来一阵轻微的松动感，像是踩空了一层。
“婉婉，小心！”她爸爸李志强脸色骤变，伸手就要去拉女儿。
可已经晚了。
那块看似结实的石块猛地一沉，直接从栈道边缘脱落。
就在这时，李婉重心瞬间失衡，身体不受控制地向外倾斜，整个人像一片被狂风卷落的叶子，朝着数百米深的悬崖下坠。
“婉婉——！”
王芬的尖叫卡在喉咙里，只发出一声破碎的气音。
她眼睁睁看着女儿脚下一滑，身影飞快地消失在悬崖边，脑袋里“嗡”的一声，彻底变成一片空白。
手一软，手机“啪嗒”掉在冰冷的石板上，屏幕摔得粉碎，她却浑然不觉。
周围的游客爆发出此起彼伏的惊呼，有人吓得后退，有人捂住嘴不敢出声。
栈道上瞬间乱作一团。
李志强强压着心脏狂跳的恐惧，手脚冰凉却还保持着最后一丝冷静。

他一把扶住瘫软的妻子，另一只手颤抖着摸出手机，指尖哆嗦得几乎按不准数字。
先后拨通了120急救电话和110报警电话，声音嘶哑得不成样子：“警察同志！救命！我女儿在玉龙雪山栈道坠崖了！快派人来救她！”
景区的反应速度堪称迅速。
接到报警与内部上报后，值班负责人立刻启动紧急预案。
警卫队、救援队、驻点医护人员全副武装，带着绳索、担架、热成像仪等设备，以最快速度冲向事发地点。
索道站临时停运，广播反复播放紧急通知，工作人员开始疏散周边游客，拉起一道道醒目的黄色警戒线。
不过十几分钟，原本热闹的观景栈道已空无一人，只剩下呼啸的寒风与来回奔走的救援人员。
警戒线外，王芬瘫坐在地上，眼泪像断了线的珠子，哭得撕心裂肺，反复念叨着女儿的名字。
李志强紧紧搂着妻子，像瞬间苍老了十几岁，眼神死死盯着那片深不见底的云雾，心脏像是被一只无形的手狠狠攥住。
救援队伍沿着悬崖边缘艰难下放，无人机在云雾中反复穿梭，可悬崖太深、雾气太浓，视线受阻，搜救进展缓慢。
所有人心里都清楚，从这么高的地方坠落，生还的可能性微乎其微。
……
content_en:
The Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, which is more than 4,600 meters above sea level, is wrapped in white snow and billowing clouds all year round.
The glacier plank road hangs on the edge of the cliff, with bottomless cliffs at your feet.
This morning, the sun finally penetrated the clouds and coated the silvery mountains with a layer of light gold.
Tourists held on to the guardrail to take photos and marvel. Li Wan's family of three also mixed in with the crowd, walking slowly along the plank road at the upper station of Glacier Park.
"Wanwan, stand a little over here, and mom will take a picture of you."
Her mother, Wang Fen, held up her mobile phone, smiling softly, constantly adjusting the angle, "Let your dad come over, and we can take a photo together as a family."
Li Wan responded with a smile, and then subconsciously moved half a step towards the connection between the plank road and the mountain.
The stone slabs here were laid in the later stages of the scenic area, with loose gravel embedded on the edges. They have been eroded by wind and snow all year round and are no longer so stable.
As soon as she stood still, she suddenly felt a slight looseness under her feet, as if she had stepped on a missing layer.
"Wanwan, be careful!" Her father Li Zhiqiang's expression suddenly changed and he reached out to pull his daughter.
But it's too late.
The seemingly solid stone suddenly sank and fell off the edge of the plank road.
At this moment, Li Wan's center of gravity suddenly lost balance, and her body tilted outward uncontrollably. Like a leaf blown off by the strong wind, Li Wan fell towards the cliff hundreds of meters deep.
"Wanwan——!"
Wang Fen's scream was stuck in her throat, and she only made a broken breath.
She watched helplessly as her daughter's foot slipped and her figure quickly disappeared from the edge of the cliff. There was a "buzzing" in her head and she went completely blank.
Her hand softened and the phone fell onto the cold stone floor with a clatter, the screen smashed to pieces, but she didn't even notice.
The surrounding tourists burst into exclamations one after another. Some people were frightened and backed away, while others covered their mouths and did not dare to speak.
There was chaos on the plank road.
Li Zhiqiang suppressed the fear of his heart racing, his hands and feet were cold but he still maintained his last trace of calmness.
He supported his limp wife and took out the phone with his other hand tremblingly. His fingertips were so trembling that he could hardly press the numbers accurately.
I dialed the 120 emergency number and the 110 police number, and my voice was hoarse: "Comrade police! Help! My daughter fell off the cliff on the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain Plank Road! Send someone to rescue her quickly!"
The response speed of the scenic spot is very fast.
After receiving the alarm and internal report, the person in charge on duty immediately launched the emergency plan.
The guards, rescue teams, and on-site medical staff were fully armed and rushed to the scene of the incident as quickly as possible with ropes, stretchers, thermal imaging cameras and other equipment.
The cableway station was temporarily suspended, emergency notices were repeatedly played on the radio, and staff began to evacuate surrounding tourists and raised eye-catching yellow cordons.
Within ten minutes, the originally bustling viewing plank road was deserted, leaving only the howling cold wind and rescue workers running back and forth.
Outside the cordon, Wang Fen sat paralyzed on the ground, her tears like broken beads. She cried heartbreakingly and chanted her daughter's name repeatedly.
Li Zhiqiang hugged his wife tightly, as if he had aged more than ten years in an instant. His eyes were fixed on the bottomless clouds, and his heart seemed to be tightly grasped by an invisible hand.
The rescue team struggled to descend along the edge of the cliff, and the drone repeatedly shuttled through the clouds and fog. However, the cliff was too deep, the fog was too thick, and the line of sight was blocked, so the search and rescue progress was slow.
Everyone knew that after falling from such a height, the possibility of survival was slim.
